en.q: Do I get both?
en.a: Yes. MWP Presets and the Lightroom Classic plugin come together, in one purchase. Neither needs the other: the presets work in Lightroom Classic, Lightroom, Lightroom Mobile and Camera Raw; the plugin works in Lightroom Classic 13 or newer.

en.q: Which programs do they work in?
en.a: Lightroom Classic, Lightroom (desktop), Lightroom Mobile and Photoshop Camera Raw. Lightroom on its own is enough. The LUTs work in Photoshop, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve and Final Cut Pro. The 12 adaptive presets need Lightroom Classic 11+, Lightroom 5+ or Camera Raw 14+.

en.q: Which Lightroom does the plugin work in?
en.a: Lightroom Classic 13 or newer, on Mac or Windows. It doesn't work in Lightroom (the cloud app), Lightroom Mobile or Photoshop. For Photoshop there's MWP Photoshop Plugin Panel.

en.q: What's in the download?
en.a: MWP Presets: 50 desktop presets (.xmp) for Lightroom Classic, Lightroom and Camera Raw, 50 mobile files (.dng) for Lightroom Mobile, 33 LUTs (.cube), video tutorials and an install guide. The Lightroom Classic plugin: the plugin for Lightroom Classic 13 or newer, with built-in help and a video tutorial.

en.q: Will they work on my photos, not only on yours?
en.a: The 12 adaptive presets use Lightroom's AI masks to find the subject, the sky and the background in each photo, so they adjust to your frame. Every photo is different: expect to set white balance and exposure after the preset, as in the examples on this page.

en.q: Can I use them on my phone only?
en.a: Yes. The pack includes 50 DNG files for Lightroom Mobile on iPhone, iPad and Android. If you also use Lightroom on desktop, install there and they sync to your phone.

en.q: Can I use the LUTs on video?
en.a: Yes. They carry the colour and tone of presets 01 to 33 and are built for standard Rec.709 footage. With LOG footage, convert to Rec.709 first, then apply the LUT.

en.q: How do I get and install the files?
en.a: Right after payment they're waiting in My downloads, in your MWP account, with a video tutorial. The pack includes an install guide with a page for each program. Most installs take a couple of minutes. The plugin is added once in Lightroom Classic: File › Plug-in Manager › Add.

en.q: Why is the plugin's window called MWP Panel?
en.a: That's the plugin's own name inside Lightroom Classic. On this site we call it the Lightroom Classic plugin, so it isn't confused with the MWP Photoshop Plugin Panel, which is a separate product.

en.q: What can I do with the files?
en.a: Use them on all your own photos and videos, including paid client work, on every device you use. The files are for you alone: please don’t share, resell or repackage them.

en.q: Can I get a refund?
en.a: If the presets or the plugin don't work for you, write to support within 14 days of purchase with your order number. We'll help you get them working, and if we can't, we'll refund you. The full terms are on our Terms page.

en.q: Do I need to know layers and masks?
en.a: No. You choose what to edit and an effect, and the panel builds the layers and masks for you. A 21-page manual and a guide inside the panel explain every button from the start.

en.q: Presets or Panel: which do I need?
en.a: If you edit in Lightroom, MWP Presets, which come with the Lightroom Classic plugin for sorting and finishing whole shoots. If you open your photos in Photoshop, MWP Photoshop Plugin Panel. If you use both apps, the Presets + Panel bundle gives you the same look in each, includes the plugin, and costs less than buying them separately.

en.q: Which Photoshop do I need?
en.a: Photoshop 2023 (version 24.2) or newer, on Mac or Windows, from a Creative Cloud subscription. It does not run in Lightroom, on iPad or on phones. Working in Lightroom Classic? MWP Presets come with a plugin for it.

en.q: Can it ruin my photo?
en.a: No. Every button adds its own layer and your original layer is locked. One Ctrl+Z (Cmd+Z on Mac) undoes a whole button, Reset MWP removes everything the panel added, and exports are always saved as new files.

en.q: Can I edit a whole series the same way?
en.a: Yes. Open the other photos, return to the edited one and click Apply under More photos. Subject, sky and background are found again on each. You can also save your edit as a look under Save my look.

en.q: Are updates included?
en.a: Yes. Updates to MWP Photoshop Plugin Panel are free: new versions appear in My downloads.

en.q: Are there video tutorials?
en.a: Yes. Every purchase includes video tutorials for the panel. You find them in My downloads, next to your files.

en.q: License, computers and refunds?
en.a: A personal licence for your own work and client work. MWP Photoshop Plugin Panel works on up to 3 computers at a time, signed in with your email; changed computer? Free one up in My downloads. If it doesn't work for you, write to support within 14 days of purchase: we'll help, and if we can't, we'll refund you.

en.q: What if I get stuck?
en.a: Start with the video tutorials in My downloads. The Installation Guide covers common problems and their fixes, and every button in the panel has a tip and a help entry. Still stuck? Write to support and a person replies within one business day.

en.q: What exactly do I get?

en.q: Is it for beginners too?
en.a: Yes. The lessons start from the basics, and every lesson ends with "Break the rule" for those who already shoot and want to go further. Start with any guide and any page.

en.q: Do I need a particular camera or gear?
en.a: No. The guides teach you to see and plan: composition, colour, light and planning. They don't depend on any camera or lens.

en.q: Do the guides cover editing?
en.a: No. They're about what happens before the click: composition, colour, light and planning. For the edit, MWP Presets and MWP Photoshop Plugin Panel carry the same approach into Lightroom and Photoshop, and both come in bundles with the guides.

en.q: Can I buy just one guide?
en.a: Not at the moment. The four guides come as one set, in the language you choose, and together they cost less than four separate guides would.

en.q: How do I get the files?
